title: Choose the visual world for GoLive Academy
question: The roll assigned the Departure Board. Keep it, take my pick, adopt an alternate, or re-roll. The reference site's look stays available as the category standard.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: airport split-flap departure boards and terminal wayfinding signage
options.thesis: Every course is a departure: module is the gate, cohort is the flight, your career go-live is the destination.
materials: split-flap tiles with a hinge seam
options.viewport: A full-width flap board headlines the hero: rows flip into 'FICO → CONSULTANT · GATE 07 · BOARDING'; the headline sits above in signage type with Explore Courses as a yellow sign-panel button.
options.risk: Becomes a travel-site costume if the metaphor leaks into copy everywhere; held to boards, gate tags and status only.

raised.raise: Ghost flaps: locked lessons, empty states and unset fields render as blank designed tiles, never as missing content.
Named phases: progress reads Check-in → Boarding → In flight → Landed in words and pattern, never colour alone.
Fixed ramp: module demand and difficulty ride one three-step scale used identically on every surface.
Board discipline: inside any board only two inks — tile and letter — no mixed greys.

options.label: Cutover War Room
options.lineage: SAP go-live cutover runbooks and project status boards
options.thesis: Your preparation run like a real go-live: T-minus countdown, cutover checklist, RAG status.
options.viewport: A T-minus countdown to the next mock batch beside a cutover checklist that ticks itself.
options.risk: Most familiar to working consultants, least to freshers; can read like a project tool rather than a school.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: Every number lit in segments, unlit cells designed too.
options.case: Fuses poorly: learners don't identify with clocks; numbers aren't the product.
options.kept: Ghost cells — empty states drawn as deliberately as filled ones.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Scroll from night to day as you move from preparing to placed.
options.viewport: A horizon band warming as the page scrolls.
options.case: Holds a nice arc, but theatre isn't the audience's world and courses lose clarity.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Modules as stars sized by demand.
options.case: Pretty, but finding your module becomes a hunt.
options.kept: One fixed magnitude ramp for hierarchy.

options.label: Moiré Gallery
options.thesis: Black and white wave fields that flex on scroll.
options.viewport: A strobing wave canvas behind the headline.
options.case: No link to SAP careers; hurts readability.

canonCard.label: The category standard (reference-faithful)
canonCard.thesis: The analysed reference's layout — navy-to-blue gradient heroes, indigo buttons, white card grids — executed at full craft with shadcn and Motion.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, illustrated product card right, three CTAs and three stats.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most course platforms by design.
